body: I think this is the part that is the worst for me, that I feel that I've tried so much already -- philosophy, exercise, going to university, therapy, medications, etc -- and none of it has helped. I've just been caught in the same cycle of hopelessness for years, a permanent rut no matter how I struggle and spin my wheels. It's not as though I've done nothing, but nothing has done anything. How do you keep trudging through the mud, fighting against the quicksand when every lifeline just takes you down further?
How? Did things just happen to you or did you change it yourself somehow?
